# `collations`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Get all of the Spark SQL string collations

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
collations()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (table function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- collations, example 1
> SELECT * FROM collations() WHERE NAME = 'UTF8_BINARY';
Error: UNRESOLVABLE_TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
